market_outlook.short_term: Risk-off environment dominates. Iran conflict and rising yields create headwinds for equities. Energy and defense outperform. Bond volatility elevated. Consumer stress continues. Expect 5-8% equity volatility over next 4-6 weeks. Rate-hike expectations may peak by mid-September, creating potential relief rally.
market_outlook.long_term: AI infrastructure capex cycle ($35B+ deals) supports tech leadership through 2027. India emerges as structural growth beneficiary. Energy transition accelerates with Hormuz bypass. Consumer credit normalization takes 12-18 months. Bond yields likely to stabilize above current levels, structurally altering equity valuations. Geopolitical fragmentation (US-China, US-Iran, US-Canada) creates persistent tail risk.
